package seedprobe

import (
	"fmt"
	"testing"
)

// TestOrder prints the order a six-entry map — one hash bucket — iterates in.
// Two -count runs share one process and one hash seed; two invocations do not.
func TestOrder(t *testing.T) {
	m := map[int]string{1: "a", 2: "b", 3: "c", 4: "d", 5: "e", 6: "f"}
	for pass := range 2 {
		var got []int
		for k := range m {
			got = append(got, k)
		}
		fmt.Printf("range %d: %v\n", pass, got)
	}
}
